seoTitle: Douglas County School District Calendar 2029-2030 | Holidays & PDF
seoDescription: View the DCSD 2029-2030 school calendar with the August 8 first day, May 23 last day, 173 student days, breaks, PLC delayed starts, and official PDF.
heroSummary: Douglas County School District begins the 2029-30 conventional school year on Wednesday, August 8, 2029, and the last student day is Thursday, May 23, 2030. The calendar lists 173 student days, Fall Break on October 8-12, Winter Break on December 24-January 5, and Spring Break on March 18-22. The PDF separates PLC delayed starts and staff-only dates from full student closures.
calendarNotes: The 2029-30 DCSD school calendar lists 173 student days. The first student day is August 8, 2029, and the second semester begins January 8, 2030 after a January 7 teacher work day. Fall Break runs October 8-12. Thanksgiving closure spans November 19-23, with November 21 marked as a compensation day and November 22-23 marked as district holidays. Winter Break runs December 24-January 5, with January 7 reserved for teacher work. Spring Break runs March 18-22, followed by professional development on April 19, a compensation day on April 22, and a teacher work day on May 24.

customSections.label: Planning Around the 2029-30 DCSD Calendar
customSections.content: The conventional PDF is designed for a quick visual scan, but its markers have different family consequences. Treat PLC dates as delayed starts, staff dates as no-student days, and the break color as a full student closure unless DCSD publishes a revision.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Douglas County School District start in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day of the DCSD 2029-30 conventional calendar is Wednesday, August 8, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: When is DCSD Spring Break in 2030?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 18 through Friday, March 22, 2030.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of DCSD school in 2030?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 23, 2030. May 24 is marked as a teacher work day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does a PLC date mean DCSD students have no school?
calendarFaqs.a: No. PLC Day is labeled as a delayed-start day. Families should check their school's bell schedule rather than treating it as a full closure.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the DCSD 2029-30 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official DCSD calendar identifies 173 all-day student sessions.
